capabilities: Collapse and expand grouped rows in Bases table and card views
Nest groups by splitting /-delimited property values or by extra sub-group columns
Edit note properties inline in table cells, including checkboxes, text, dates, tags, and links
Render card views with cover images, filename overlays, and up to four truthy-property badges
Strip a leading path prefix (or this.file.folder) to show clean folder-based MOC groupings
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.10.2 or later with the Bases core plugin available; beta installation via BRAT is documented; the listing notes it has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: tries to be a drop-in replacement for both the Obsidian Bases Table and Card views
motivation: The author notes Obsidian did not provide an extendible BaseTable object, so the views had to be coded from scratch to behave as a drop-in replacement.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Bases table and card views show grouped results as flat lists that cannot fold, nest hierarchically, or be edited inline.
summary: Bases table and card views with collapsible, nestable groups, inline cell editing, and badge-marked cards.
